newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Hydro up on good outlook, result.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Hydro up on good outlook, result.

text.p: Shares in Scottish Hydro-Electric Plc advanced on Thursday after the electricity generator said it had started well to the current financial year.
By 0745 GMT, the stock was up 4-1/2p to 425-1/2p.
"We think they are one of the best in the sector", one trader said. "And the outlook for them is bright".
Earlier, Scottish Hydro said its pre-tax profit rose 5.3 percent to 205.4 million stg., matching the analysts forecasts.
It would work on plans to take advantage of the liberalisation of the domestic electricity market in 1998 and would aim for market share of eight percent in 1999, it said.
